title: China New-Energy Passenger Vehicle Exports Rise 138.8%
summary: China&\#x27;s new-energy passenger vehicle exports rose 138.8% year on year to 3.887 million in the first three quarters of 2026, while domestic retail sales fell 12.8% to 7.758 million, Sina Finance reported. The report said exports became an important support for automakers&\#x27; sales growth.
